review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one non-recursive definition (DeductivelyEquivalent), one completeness-based inclusion lemma, one iff-to-equivalence lemma, and two transport lemmas (.mp and .mpr). None of them carries a simp attribute. Uses elsewhere (Equivalence.lean, HailperinPresentationBridge.lean) only state or apply the equivalence. I found no evidence of a missing canonical simp lemma, a bad orientation, competing rules, or a rewrite loop. A simp attribute on the transport lemmas would be unsuitable because they have hypotheses of the form T ⊢ₛ' f, which are not rewrite equations. I did not inspect those downstream files in detail.
